narrative.intro: Southwest Valley Constructors obligated $2.3B in federal contracts in FY2026 to date. Southwest Valley Constructors won 5 awards this fiscal year, with an average award size of $451M. The Department of Homeland Security is the dominant buyer, obligating $2.2B. The Department of Defense is a secondary buyer, obligating $10.6M. Commercial and Institutional Building Construction is the primary NAICS market for Southwest Valley Constructors, with obligations of $2.2B. Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction is a secondary market, with obligations of $10.6M. Annual obligations include an earlier FY21 total of $78.4M before the current FY2026 total. The note: current-year totals are partial (fiscal year to date) and the figures presented are contract obligations except award-value figures shown elsewhere as total contract values. This profile focuses on obligations, buying agencies, and the industry sectors that account for the bulk of Southwest Valley Constructors federal work.

sections.heading: Who are the main federal buyers of Southwest Valley Constructors?
sections.body: The Department of Homeland Security obligated $2.2B for Southwest Valley Constructors in FY2026 to date. The Department of Defense obligated $10.6M. Those two agencies are the listed buying agencies and reflect the companys concentration in building and infrastructure work.

sections.heading: What markets and contract sizes dominate Southwest Valley Constructors' federal work?
sections.body: Commercial and Institutional Building Construction accounts for $2.2B of obligations for Southwest Valley Constructors. Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction accounts for $10.6M. The five awards in FY2026 to date average $451M each, indicating concentration in a small number of large awards.

faq.q: How much does Southwest Valley Constructors make from federal contracts?
faq.a: Southwest Valley Constructors obligated $2.3B from federal contracts in FY2026 to date. That total reflects the fiscal-year-to-date contract obligations reported for the company and is a partial-year figure.

faq.q: Which agencies buy from Southwest Valley Constructors?
faq.a: The Department of Homeland Security and the Department of Defense buy from Southwest Valley Constructors. The Department of Homeland Security obligated $2.2B and the Department of Defense obligated $10.6M in FY2026 to date.

faq.q: What does Southwest Valley Constructors sell to the government?
faq.a: Southwest Valley Constructors sells construction services to the government. Commercial and Institutional Building Construction accounts for $2.2B of obligations and Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction accounts for $10.6M.
